title: Completed table unused media column removal
summary: Remove the unused Media column from the Completed current and history tables so it no longer appears as an empty spacer between Title and Route.
reason: The Completed table renderer left the media column blank for many daily-use rows, creating a visible spacer that consumed horizontal space without helping the operator scan output evidence.
behavior_before: Completed current/history tables rendered a Media column between Title and Route, which could appear empty and behave like a spacer.
behavior_after: Completed current/history tables move Route directly after Title and keep Evidence, Size, Publish, and Final aligned without the unused spacer column.
rollback_plan: Revert the Completed partial, table renderer, component CSS, and focused title-cell test updates to restore the prior eight-column table.
notes:
WebView presentation-only change. No backend route, filesystem mutation, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, settings persistence, or process lifecycle behavior changes.
Removed unused Completed table media column and shifted renderer/CSS/test indexes.
PowerShell smoke wrapper Test-WebViewBrowserCompletedPendingProofSmoke.ps1 was attempted first but stopped at webview_browser_smoke_common.ps1 stderr handling before showing unittest output; direct invocation of the same unittest module passed.
